project.name: Faridh Fikri — Surrealist World Portfolio
project.audience: Recruiters and professional contacts evaluating Faridh's documented legal, HRGA, administrative and sales experience.
project.constraints: Keep complete four-role CV facts, real portrait, actual contact details, and three authored impasto paintings unchanged. No invented professional projects. Native scrolling, sensible mobile and reduced-motion layouts.

evidence.claim: Four distinct real professional roles and organizations, their dates and tasks, recorded in the existing verified-content ledger and four HTML articles.
The three full-resolution impasto artworks were created within the Lazarus project, preserved in this repo, and clearly presented as metaphoric editorial images, not Faridh's employment evidence.
The original Faridh portrait is retained unmodified and the facts and contact channels are unaltered.

selections.why: The career narrative comprises four verified CV-backed settings. A single environmental impasto painting provides consistent art direction while reading evidence changes by chapter; visual emphasis tracks the active real role.
selections.readerBenefit: Readers can inspect four different actual responsibilities while retaining a stable chapter context, without flipping through decorative case-study cards.
selections.implementation: CSS sticky full-bleed scene; four semantic work articles remain in ordinary scroll order. Existing app.js owns the active chapter; advance.js reflects that one canonical value to presentation data attributes.
selections.stateSource: Actual active work article derived by app.js chooseIndex() and exposed through #work-count (1..4); no parallel progress clocks.
nonTransferable: Reference demo's colors, cards and labels
Reference demo's exact viewport rhythm and layout
selections.rejectionConsidered: Depth-parallax layers and continuous scrub would turn a complete painting into fabricated movable fragments and distract from the CV facts.

fallback.noJs: All four work articles and the full painting remain in source order, without script-dependent access or empty pinned space.
fallback.reducedMotion: Full painting becomes an ordinary finite-height visual scene preceding all four vertically stacked career entries.
fallback.mobile: At 320 and 390 px the full-width scene precedes the directly accessible native swipeable four-entry chapter strip, with real next and previous controls.

selections.why: At small widths, the four real career entries form a finite directly navigable group which must not become a forced vertical-to-horizontal scrolling animation.
selections.readerBenefit: Readers can directly swipe four role chapters or use previous and next buttons while each role keeps its original complete job description.
selections.implementation: Native overflow-x:auto and scroll-snap-type:x proximity; existing real previous/next buttons navigate chapter offsets; no custom pointer dragging.
selections.stateSource: Native #work-pages scrollLeft and article offsetLeft, read by the same canonical app.js chooseIndex() used by sticky evidence presentation.
nonTransferable: Source demo's colors and UI chrome
Source demo's figure sizing and layout
selections.rejectionConsidered: A pinned horizontal theatre would trap long CV copy and break touch/keyboard access; a long single column loses direct chapter navigation on mobile.

fallback.noJs: The horizontal overflow container and every career article remain swipe/keyboard scrollable even without JavaScript; no buttons required to expose information.
fallback.reducedMotion: Motion-free vertical stacking of all four articles takes precedence over mandatory swipe; the source document remains complete.
fallback.mobile: Direct touch swipe plus buttons and native proximity snapping; each factual chapter is fully legible at 320 and 390 CSS px.

rejected.reason: Three completed paintings have no independently sourced image depth layers; separating visual objects would fabricate a spatial structure and distract from the professional evidence.
The former full-screen text wipe was another dominant interaction. It adds spectacle without helping compare four CV roles, so the statement is now static and legible.
An image zoom does not communicate a verified detail and can introduce crop distortion and vestibular discomfort.

qa.environment: GitHub Actions Playwright Chromium at seven responsive widths; release gate awaits manual visual and device signoff.
